project_info.color_palette: Soft strawberry pink, translucent red, white aluminum, ice clear, leaf green

main_subject.detail: A sleek white DOC Soda Strawberry aluminum can floats diagonally across the center, with the label readable and the lower rim closest to camera.
main_subject.style: Ultra-real premium beverage photography, high-speed advertising capture

items: Center: diagonal white soda can with crisp red typography.
Across background: two large translucent red soda ribbons flowing diagonally.
Around can: ripe strawberries, clear angular ice cubes, and suspended red droplets.
Background: seamless light red-to-pink studio gradient.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Strong key, soft fill, rim highlights, glossy liquid reflections, sharp ice refraction, frozen droplets

assets.name: DOC Soda Strawberry can
assets.usage: Preserve the can silhouette, label typography, color, and logo.

prompt_instructions: Keep the can diagonal and central; all fruit and ice must remain secondary.
Do not replace visible packaging text with generated text.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-realistic premium product photography of a sleek white aluminum soda can labeled “DOC Soda Strawberry,” floating diagonally across the frame at a dynamic tilted angle, surrounded by fresh whole strawberries and crystal-clear ice cubes suspended in mid-air. Vibrant translucent red strawberry soda liquid streams and splashes diagonally behind and around the can, forming elegant flowing ribbons with glossy highlights and scattered droplets frozen in motion. The strawberries appear ripe and saturated red with visible seeds and green leafy tops, while the ice cubes are highly transparent with sharp edges, internal reflections, and realistic refraction. The can surface is smooth matte aluminum with subtle metallic sheen, crisp typography, and clean graphic design. Shot in a controlled studio environment with a seamless soft red-to-pink gradient background and matching color palette, emphasizing freshness and flavor. Lighting is high-end commercial studio lighting with strong key light, soft fill, and rim highlights, producing sharp reflections on ice and liquid, soft shadows, and high contrast clarity. Camera angle is slightly low and diagonal, medium close-up framing, shallow depth of field with razor-sharp focus on the can and foreground elements. Mood is energetic, refreshing, modern, and premium, hyper-photorealistic, cinematic advertising style, ultra-detailed, 8K, high-speed flash capture, luxury beverage brand.
prompt.negative_prompt: altered can label, flat splash, opaque ice, unripe fruit, messy composition, blurry can, wrong logo, low resolution, watermark
